responsibility: Implements C++ name lookup and scope binding management, including GCC’s module-aware binding structures. It creates and updates local and namespace bindings, pushes and pops scopes, classes, namespaces, and top-level contexts, performs unqualified and qualified lookup support, handles using declarations/directives and debug emission for them, maintains special overloaded/type ‘stat hack’ bindings, and caches operator bindings needed for dependent template expressions.
same_name_distinction: Implements the runtime behavior of C++ lookup and scope management—creating/updating bindings, traversing scopes and namespaces, handling module-aware binding vectors, using directives, debug emission, and cached operator bindings. Unlike name-lookup.h, which defines the binding representations and API, this file executes the lookup algorithms.
